scientific_role: Conventional baseline rebuild. E_reason promotion is suspended until this layer passes.
immutable_parent: F0 remains an immutable preliminary historical snapshot and is not rewritten.
diagnosis: F0 mean family V0_PERSIST survived the historical mean-model hindcast; attempted transported global/regional CLR swings were worse.
F0 uncertainty V2 was selected on aggregate componentwise coverage and can hide severe party-level undercoverage/overcoverage.
F0/F-1 ballot support is provisional and historically anchored until a certified 2026 legal ballot snapshot exists.
E_reason was tested before the conventional baseline had completed its post-selection uncertainty refit and final ballot support update.
A transformed residual metric may not be used as a primary target if it degrades actual vote-share or seat-relevant performance.

mean_layer.reason: Keep the only point-mean family that survived the frozen 2016_TO_2021 hindcast. Do not invent a subjective national-dynamics point shift.
mean_layer.national_state: National swing is modeled as a zero-mean latent uncertainty factor, not as an unvalidated point correction.

uncertainty_layer.decomposition: For each transition: CLR innovation = transition-wide national vector + territory-centered deviation.
uncertainty_layer.candidate_family: For a held-out transition, generate zero-mean national shock z * national_vector_from_other_transition and independently bootstrap territory-centered residual vectors from the other transition.
uncertainty_layer.crossfit: Symmetric leave-one-transition-out development: each historical transition is held out once. This is post-2021 model development, not a new blind validation.
uncertainty_layer.robust_simplex_cap: Same historical max + 0.05 rule as uncertainty V2.
selection: Eligibility first: every party must clear the sampling-tolerance coverage floors in each held-out transition.
Then minimize mean absolute party calibration error across 80% and 95% intervals.
Then lower proper Energy Score on sqrt-compositions.
Then smaller total scale as deterministic tie-breaker.
uncertainty_layer.sharpness_comparator: Selected F1 mean 95% width must be strictly lower than F0 uncertainty V2 selected width; equality/failure is not an improvement.

ballot_layer.rule: Announced/investiture rosters may inform provisional support diagnostics but cannot replace the legal ballot. Final F1 seat publication requires a certified 2026 ballot/list-presence snapshot.
ballot_layer.minor_list_rule: Do not silently assume the 2021 minor-list universe is the final 2026 universe.

promotion_order: F1 historical uncertainty development and refit
F1 provisional then frozen 2026 vote/seat distribution
Only then reopen deterministic candidate/list delta and E_reason incremental tests
forbidden: Declare calibration from aggregate coverage alone
Treat Medias24 announced candidates as the final legal ballot without certification
Tune an E_reason feature after seeing its 2021 outcome inside the same experiment
Invoke an LLM before F1 baseline preflight passes
